title: 389. Flip Game

examples.explanation: Each of the three adjacent pairs flips once.
Only the trailing pair can flip.
No "++" exists, so no move is possible.

hints: Scan every adjacent pair of positions once and test whether both hold '+'..., hide the literal: say both hold a plus sign.
Build each answer by copying the board and flipping just the chosen pair.
Boards with no flippable pair produce an empty result list.
